title: 第十章 雁过拔毛、兽走留皮的坑货枫溪
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在她认下白玥时，就真把对方当成姐姐来看待。

“不用多说，我信你的话。”

白玥的声音透着几分沉重，她沉声道：“只是，这酒不是你的，你多拿月光酿，会不会让他生气？”

白玥口中的他自然说的是月魔神阿加雷斯。

她当然知道她们是在月魔神阿加雷斯的行宫之中，这里的酒很显然都是月魔神阿加雷斯的珍藏。

第一天来到魔皇宫的白玥是惶恐不安的。

闻言，枫溪哎嘿了一声，轻声道：“在我看来，这都不重要，重要的是你喝就行了。”

“这都是小问题。”

“阿加雷斯叔叔不会跟我们生气的！”

“他巴不得有人能品尝他的美酒呢。以我们父皇和阿加雷斯叔叔的关系，月光酿全部拿走都不会让他生气的。”

枫溪一本正经地开始胡说八道起来。

月魔神阿加雷斯当然没有那么好，但是不代表枫溪不要脸啊。

为了这些美酒，她可以不要自己的形象了。毕竟，能坑一次算一次。

枫溪想的是这一次过去了，她再想从月魔神阿加雷斯这边薅羊毛那是很难了。

因此，她这一次要多薅点。

做坏事的时候，不管是人还是魔都不会觉得累，心情还处于愉悦的状态之中。

枫溪用行动证明了这一点，她的手再次伸在池子内，把靠自己这边的花瓣弄到手，然后再用自身灵力破掉那些封印。

要是其他人，肯定会被月魔神阿加雷斯的封印所挡住，不能拿到月光酿。

枫溪能如此轻易破解他的魔法封印，是因为有逆天魔龙柱的帮助。

很早的时候，枫溪就得到了逆天魔龙柱的认可。她有事没事就去找逆天魔龙柱唠嗑，继而得知了月魔神柱和星魔神柱的一些秘密。

逆天魔龙柱的日柱守护者、月魔神柱的月柱守护者、星魔神柱的星柱守护者，他们三个的关系特别好。

一些秘密，他们只告诉了枫溪，就是因为这孩子讨喜，经常跟他们讲话，让他们在孤寂的生活之中能有一抹乐趣。

“五十、六十、七十、八十……”

枫溪一边拿着一边数着，然后放进了自己的空间戒指之中。

她现在特别开心。

要不是要维持自己的淑女形象，枫溪的龙尾巴早就出来，然后摇起来了。

面对枫溪土匪似的模样，白玥瞪大眼眸，小声地说着，“你拿太多了也不好吧……”

白玥倒不是觉得枫溪的品德有问题，而是怕枫溪被打啊。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When she recognized Bai Yue, she really treated him as a sister.

"No need to say more, I believe what you say."

Bai Yue's voice was a little heavy, and she said solemnly: "It's just that this wine is not yours. If you use more moonlight to brew it, will it make him angry?"

The person Bai Yue was talking about was of course the Moon Demon God Agares.

Of course she knew that they were in the palace of Moon Demon God Agares, and the wine here was obviously the collection of Moon Demon God Agares.

Bai Yue was frightened when she arrived at the Demon Palace on her first day.

Hearing this, Fengxi let out a sigh and said softly: "In my opinion, none of this is important. What's important is that you just drink."

"These are minor issues."

"Uncle Agares will not be angry with us!"

"He hopes that someone can taste his wine. With the relationship between our father and Uncle Agares, taking away all the moonshine wine will not make him angry."

Fengxi started talking nonsense seriously.

Of course Moon Demon God Agares is not that good, but that doesn't mean Fengxi is shameless.

For the sake of these fine wines, she could give up her image.After all, if you can get cheated once, you count it once.

What Fengxi thinks is that this time has passed, and it will be difficult for her to get wool from the Moon Demon God Agares.

Therefore, she will gather more this time.

When doing bad things, neither humans nor demons feel tired, and they are still in a happy state.

Fengxi proved this with her actions. She stretched her hand into the pool again, got the petals on her side, and then used her spiritual power to break the seals.

If it were anyone else, they would definitely be blocked by the seal of Moon Demon God Agares and would not be able to get the moonlight brew.

Fengxi was able to break his magic seal so easily because of the help of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Pillar.

Very early on, Fengxi was recognized by the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Pillar.When she had something to do, she went to chat with the Heaven-defying Demon Dragon Pillar, and then learned some secrets of the Moon Demon God Pillar and the Star Demon God Pillar.

The Guardian of the Sun Pillar of the Heaven-defying Demon Dragon Pillar, the Guardian of the Moon Pillar of the Moon Demon Pillar, and the Guardian of the Star Pillar of the Star Demon Pillar, the three of them have a particularly good relationship.

They only told Fengxi some secrets because the child was lovable and often talked to them, allowing them to have a little fun in their lonely lives.

"Fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty..."

Fengxi counted it while holding it, and then put it into his own space ring.

She is very happy now.

If she didn't want to maintain her ladylike image, Fengxi's dragon tail would have come out and started wagging.

Facing Fengxi's bandit-like appearance, Bai Yue widened her eyes and whispered, "It's not good if you take too much..."

Bai Yue didn't think there was anything wrong with Fengxi's moral character, but she was afraid that Fengxi would be beaten.

title_en: Chapter 10: The geese pluck out their hair, and the animals leave their skins when they leave Fengxi.
